research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen biography, first-party long and short CVs, earlier publicly mirrored CV, university employer profile, RBA accounts, Australia Institute newsletter, Don Dunstan annual report and first speech reviewed. Full-time private/public totals remain null, not zero.

Academic leave: earlier CV records June–September 1990 parental leave; July 1993–July 1994 parental leave (adjacent heading inconsistently says 1992–93); January–June 1998 unpaid leave; June 2001–August 2002 unpaid leave for political advice. Payment for parental leave unknown. Three study-leave periods are mentioned without a complete chronology. Its aggregate 40-month leave statement is not an extra interval. Resolve original archived CV before arithmetic.

Academic titles include 1997 senior lecturer, 2002 associate professor, and Centre for Labour Research director by September 2002. Earlier CV also lists a 1998 ANU fellowship award and 1999–2000 visiting research appointment; payment, institutional relationship and overlap need verification. Research consultancies in that CV may be university projects rather than personal employment; seek contracts before adding separate employers.

Further governance/service is evidenced in the full CV, not assumed paid employment: AIRAANZ leadership 2004–2008; Festival of Ideas board 2005–2009; ABS labour advisory group 2008–2011; SA public-sector performance advisory board 2008–2010; federal employment/equality advisory and award panels; earlier vocational-training and women’s-employment committees. These are retained as follow-up leads for remuneration and complete appointment dates, not headline years.

TAFE research: Trading Tradition (1986), https://files.eric.ed.gov/fulltext/ED275843.pdf, identifies Pocock on a steering committee, not as its project director. Do not confuse that publication with her 1985–1986 project. Grant years differ across CV versions and do not supply employment dates.

Source gaps: APH privileges report 126 direct page returned 403; political claims about union hours are not independently verified employment evidence. An obsolete Australia Institute newsletter URL returned 404, and later PDF text opening returned Internal Error; indexed September 2002 director list supplied usable contemporaneous evidence. These were source errors, not job-wide errors.

Follow-up: identify early employers and research-project payroll entities; obtain actual full-time/part-time appointments for RBA, NSW departments and universities; resolve SACAE transfer, academic leave and fellowship overlap, paid status of visiting/emeritus/consultancy activity, and governance date conflicts. Last follow-up 2026-10-01; advance to Amanda Rishworth after remote save.
